title: Gateway guide: PSTN integration
description: Section on PSTN-specific concerns. Jigasi-style bridge architecture. Dial-in flow (PSTN call→SIP trunk→gateway→VTCParticipant create). gatewayPin matching to associate inbound calls with VTCCalls. Dial-out flow (moderator VTCParticipant/set create→gateway→PSTN outbound). Caller ID handling and trust (spoofing risk). E.164 formatting. DTMF relay via VTCGatewaySignal. Toll-free vs local numbers.
